[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] Alpheus Communications was a Texas regional fiber-optic network and data center provider serving the Dallas-Fort Worth, Austin, San Antonio, and Houston corridor, including a data center in Fort Worth. LOGIX Communications, later rebranded LOGIX Fiber Networks, completed its acquisition of Alpheus on January 3, 2018, with financial terms not disclosed. The deal expanded LOGIXs fiber footprint to more than 5,800 route miles and 180,000 fiber miles across Texas, and the combined company connected to roughly 75 Texas data centers while operating its own facilities across the Dallas, Austin, San Antonio, and Houston markets. Alpheuss employees and customers were absorbed into LOGIX rather than continuing as a separate brand, and available sources do not specify whether the Alpheus-branded Fort Worth data center building itself was retained, sold, or decommissioned after the merger. Because Alpheus is no longer an independently operating company, this registry records its research status as exhausted rather than complete, and flags the entity for reconciliation against LOGIX Fiber Networks during the facility-level research phase, since any physical facility still listed under the Alpheus name most likely now operates under LOGIX. This research was carried out at the operator level in an earlier phase of this project.

reading.body:
Alpheus DataCenter in Austin, Texas was registered to Alpheus Communications, a regional fiber and data center operator that was acquired by LOGIX Fiber Networks in January 2018 and ceased independent operations. The research status is exhausted because Alpheus no longer operates as a company, and any facility still carrying the Alpheus name most likely now operates under LOGIX. No published power capacity, IT load specification, or current operator confirmation is available for this address.

Without published megawatt figures, the campus cannot be ranked by capacity or compared to other facilities. Texas has 133 mapped data center locations, of which only 18 publish power specifications totaling 468 megawatts. This facility is not among those 18 publishers.

The address falls outside current operator research scope. Reconciliation against LOGIX Fiber Networks during facility-level research would be necessary to establish whether this location still operates, under what ownership, and at what scale.
